title: Does anyone else get sinus pressure when seeing a Disney animation?
content: I would've posted this in r/astralprojection, but that sub is kind of a clownshow imo and thought I'd have better luck here. I was just wondering if anyone else has had a moment of what feels like sinus pressure near the bridge of their nose immediately after seeing a Disney animated character. Only once have I gotten this sensation from a non-Disney image (I think it was a Fox animation). I get that this area between your eyes is where the third eye is and the feeling is mostly likely coming from that, since I'm not producing mucus or having any sort of allergic response. I've been getting this reaction my whole life and still get it pretty much every time I see a Disney pic. It feels like the pressure when diving to the bottom of a pool. I have my own theory of what's going on here, but was just wondering if anyone else gets this. It'd add some validity to the idea of there being thoughtform infrastructure created from Disney animations, which is similar to the mall world thing.
